I’ve only had two disputes over the course of that time and square does not do a good job at protecting the business owner when it comes to the dispute process and my case customer flat out disputed an entire ticket of services that was completed over a month ago. 
And despite me doing my due diligence documentation, including a third-party shop management software, which is paid for monthly squares, dispute process handling is very limited and I actually wonder if they have any success and successfully resolve and disputes on behalf of the business owner they provide you zero information about the customers bank or card prohibiting you from responding to the dispute directly, which severely hurts your chances of winning the dispute for legitimate business owners like myself it’s quite concerning. Other than that, it’s a very solid app dependable consistent, and the loans and cash flow booths really come in handy.

reviews.text: Perfect for small business!!. This is such an incredibly practical and useful platform for small businesses, I’ve been running this for over two years now, and it is comprehensive for what I need. I highly recommend this platform.

Square fees. I’ve been using Square for my business, and I want to provide some direct feedback based on my experience.

First, your processing fees are simply too high for the value being delivered. As a small business owner operating on tight margins, every percentage point matters and at this point, your pricing structure feels out of alignment with what competitors are offering.

Second, the invoicing system is underwhelming. While it’s functional, it lacks the level of customization, professionalism, and flexibility that I need to present polished, high-quality estimates and invoices to my customers. For a platform positioned as a business solution, this feels like a missed mark.

Because of these issues, I am actively exploring alternative payment processors that offer more competitive rates and stronger invoicing capabilities.

I wanted to share this feedback in case it’s helpful. I would absolutely consider staying with Square if improvements were made in pricing and product quality but as it stands, it’s becoming difficult to justify continuing to use the platform.

Sincerely,
Mike Sprinkle

Limitations. Most of the features are solid and easy to use. I have the Plus version. Customization of invoices and branding are very limited. If you’re selling a simple product, it’s great. 

Banking has been not meeting my expectations. There is a $2500 check deposit maximum, which for a contractor is not viable. ACH has a 1% fee as opposed to Novo which has none. 

And my first check deposit was flagged as a suspicious which had to be resolved by support. Then my second took over a week to clear. I don’t recommend banking with square if you will accept checks.
